title: Senior Compliance Analyst
description:
**About Invesco**
=================

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**What's in it for you?**
=========================

As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.

Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares

**Job Description**
===================

**Who we are**

With over $2.5 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.

**Your Team**

This position would be part of Center of Excellence (CoE) for Investment Compliance and provide necessary assistance to Global Investment Compliance (IC) function from Hyderabad office. This role would support EMEA Region, in accordance with relevant regulations (like: UCITS, FCA, COLL, etc.) and fund-specific investment restrictions as contained in the prospectus or investment management agreement. This role requires applicable IC related skills (experience in rule coding, rule testing, post trade monitoring and allied reporting) to be effective.

**Your Role**

  

* Independently address day-to-day compliance alerts/warnings in batch compliance related to trading strategies and the application of technology-based or manual controls.
* Perform daily reviews of portfolio transactions and monitor compliance investment restrictions applicable to holdings and transactions; investigate active and passive breaches and follow up with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Analyze complex compliance exceptions, document review rationale, and prepare supporting evidence to demonstrate that appropriate processes and controls meet applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain the Compliance Block facility, ensuring that relevant systems are updated to accurately reflect the current block position.
* Independently resolve queries and compliance issues from Regional Compliance and other stakeholders, applying sound judgement to identify effective solutions and escalating material or complex matters where required.
* Review relevant processes and procedures, identify control gaps or inefficiencies, and support practical process improvements and standardization.
* Perform daily manual monitoring activities outside the OMS and complete required compliance list updates in the OMS.
* Collaborate with Regional Compliance teams to assess, document, monitor, report, develop, coordinate, and implement compliance monitoring activities, ongoing testing, and related controls.
* Support compliance-related projects, system changes, account onboarding, user acceptance testing (UAT), and other related responsibilities.
* Perform daily monitoring of overdrawn funds by comparing cash reports received from the Reconciliation team with CRD reports and notify relevant teams for timely resolution. **Perform quality checks and provide guidance to analysts and new team members as required.**

**Working Timings:**

The standard working hours will primarily align with the EMEA region, from 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST. Based on business requirements, the shift may be extended to 10:30 PM IST. Additionally, Daylight Saving Time (DST) adjustments and other operational needs may necessitate changes in shift timings. Employees are expected to maintain flexibility and be prepared to work in any shift as required by business needs to ensure operational continuity.

**The Experience You Bring**

  

* Total work experience of 4-6 years required including relevant work experience from asset management industry preferably with an investment advisor or mutual fund group in Compliance or regulatory environment. The candidate should have demonstrated experience in independently handling investment compliance monitoring, complex breach analysis, rule coding or testing and stakeholder queries.

  

* Strong knowledge of and experience with Equity/Fixed Income/ETF Products required, including UCITS Funds, Institutional Products and 40 Act Funds. Knowledge of securities regulation as it relates to operations within advisor compliance programs is required. Experience in complex investment guideline interpretation and automated compliance monitoring is preferred.

  

* Experience with regulatory environments such as SEC, ERISA, CSSF and FCA is required. Working knowledge of control documentation, operational risk management and audit support would be advantageous.

**Academic requirements**

B. Com / M. Com / MBA /CA / Degree in Commerce/Finance

**Full Time / Part Time**
=========================

  
Full time  

**Worker Type**
===============

  
Employee  

**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
=========================

  
No  

**Workplace Model**
===================

At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least four days a week, with one day working outside an Invesco office.

**Grow Your Career with Us**
============================

Build the skills and experiences that help you thrive in a constantly evolving business environment. Our AI-enabled learning platform provides personalized learning opportunities based on your role and interests, while development programs and leadership training help support continuous career growth.

**To know more about us:**

About Invesco: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/home.html

About our Culture: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/about-us/our-culture.html

https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/our-commitments/diversity-and-inclusion.html

title: Associate Director DDIT ISC AI Compliance Enablement
description:
### **Summary**

The Associate Director, AI Compliance Enablement will help transform how Information Security & Compliance (ISC) delivers compliance through the responsible use of AI, automation and digital technologies. The role will identify and implement opportunities to automate compliance activities, improve control monitoring and assurance, and reduce manual effort across ISC processes. It will also help translate AI governance, security and compliance requirements into scalable controls and solutions that enable Novartis to adopt AI responsibly. Working across ISC, DDIT and other key stakeholders, the role will connect compliance expertise with technology and innovation to create simpler, faster and more sustainable compliance capabilities.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled compliance capabilities, using AI, intelligent agents and automation to simplify processes and strengthen compliance outcomes.
* Shape scalable approaches for Compliance-as-Code, Governance-as-Code and Policy-as-Code, enabling more continuous and automated assurance.
* Translate AI governance, regulatory and risk management requirements into practical processes, controls and technology-enabled solutions.
* Support effective governance across the lifecycle of AI applications, models, agents and AI-enabled business processes, including risk classification, assessment, monitoring and control validation.
* Design and implement automated compliance workflows, including evidence collection, control testing, monitoring, risk assessments and evidence reviews.
* Build reusable automation capabilities across compliance domains such as information security, SOX, GxP, privacy and AI governance.
* Collaborate with security, technology, architecture and governance teams to identify and address emerging AI security, compliance and assurance risks.
* Provide product leadership for strategic compliance capabilities, partnering with engineering and platform teams to develop scalable, sustainable solutions.
* Modernize compliance processes through AI, automation, analytics and intelligent workflows, focusing on solving meaningful compliance challenges rather than simply digitizing existing processes.
* Define meaningful metrics and insights to demonstrate compliance effectiveness, control performance and automation value, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  

  

**Essential Requirements**

  
  

* University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Compliance, Data Science or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in Information Security, Compliance, IT Risk Management, Audit, Data Privacy, AI Governance or another relevant discipline.
* Experience working within complex, global and regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of risk management, controls and governance frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to connect technical, compliance and business perspectives.
* Experience with Generative AI, AI agents or AI governance. Experience designing or implementing compliance automation.
  

  

**Desirable Requirements**

  
  

* Understanding of Compliance-as-Code, Policy-as-Code or continuous controls monitoring concepts. Experience with technologies such as Azure AI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, ServiceNow or similar platforms.
* Experience with SOX, GxP, cybersecurity or data privacy compliance.Familiarity with emerging AI regulatory requirements, standards and risk management frameworks.

title: Accounts & Compliance Executive
description:
**About us.** e Design Services is a growing electrical and technical contracting firm in Hyderabad, delivering commercial renovations and corporate utility upgrades. We are rolling out our own in-house ERP and need a sharp, careful accountant to own our books and statutory compliance work.

**What you'll do**

* Keep daily books in Tally Prime: sales, purchase, journal, bank and cash vouchers, with weekly bank reconciliation
* Raise sales invoices, record and file vendor and purchase bills, track receivables and vendor payments, and maintain clear ledgers
* Generate e-way bills for materials moving to project sites
* Prepare GST sales and purchase registers and reconcile purchases against GSTR-2B for our CA
* Handle day-to-day PF and ESIC work with management approval: new-joiner and exit updates (UAN, ESIC IP number), monthly return files and challans, and contribution records; prepare Professional Tax data
* Maintain master data in our in-house ERP (vendors, clients, materials, employees, attendance) and keep it matched to Tally
* Match vendor bills to purchase orders and coordinate with vendors and site supervisors
* Close each month on a checklist and send a weekly cash and receivables summary

**What we're looking for**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent
* 1–2 years' hands-on Tally Prime and GST accounting
* Independent e-way bill experience
* Working knowledge of PF, ESIC and Professional Tax (Telangana) is preferred
* Good Excel; comfortable learning a new ERP
* Careful, honest, and able to own deadlines; English plus Telugu or Hindi
* Good to have: contracting or construction accounting experience

**What we offer**

* Fixed monthly salary of ₹20,000–25,000 (gross), depending on experience
* 3-month probation, then confirmation with Provident Fund (EPF)
* Notice period: 15 days during probation, 30 days after confirmation
* Clear ownership of your work and a structured first 90 days

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Company Secretary (CS) – Listed Company Compliance
description:
Department: Legal & Secretarial

Experience: 3-5 Years

Location: Hyderabad

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and qualified Company Secretary (CS) with hands-on experience in listed company compliance, corporate governance, and regulatory filings. The candidate should have strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI regulations, and stock exchange compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with a listed company or a listed company group and be capable of independently managing secretarial compliances, Board and Committee meetings, corporate governance reporting, and coordination with regulatory authorities, auditors, and stock exchanges.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Listed Company Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI LODR).
* Handle periodic and event-based disclosures to NSE/BSE, as applicable.
* Manage quarterly, half-yearly, and annual compliance filings with stock exchanges.
* Ensure timely disclosure of material events and information under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR.
* Monitor compliance with SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015.
* Maintain the Structured Digital Database (SDD), insider trading records, and related compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with stock exchanges, SEBI, Registrar of Companies (ROC), and other regulatory authorities.
* Track regulatory updates and ensure timely implementation of changes in applicable laws and regulations.

**B. Board and Committee Management**

* Organise Board Meetings, Annual General Meetings (AGMs), Extraordinary General Meetings (EGMs), and committee meetings.
* Prepare agendas, notices, explanatory statements, minutes, and resolutions.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements relating to the Board of Directors and its committees.
* Maintain statutory registers, minute books, and other secretarial records.
* Coordinate with Directors, Independent Directors, Key Managerial Personnel (KMPs), and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with applicable provisions relating to the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and other committees.

**C. Corporate Governance and Reporting**

* Prepare the Corporate Governance Report, Annual Secretarial Compliance Report, and other applicable disclosures.
* Coordinate the preparation of the Annual Report, Board's Report, and related statutory disclosures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements relating to Independent Directors, Director appointments, resignations, and disclosures of interest.
* Monitor compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards issued by ICSI, and applicable SEBI regulations.
* Support the Board and senior management in implementing sound corporate governance practices.
* Coordinate with Practising Company Secretaries (PCS), statutory auditors, and internal auditors for compliance reviews and certifications.

**D. ROC and MCA Compliance**

* Prepare and file statutory forms and returns with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), including applicable forms relating to:
* Annual returns and financial statements.
* Appointment, resignation, and changes in Directors and KMPs.
* Board and shareholder resolutions.
* Creation, modification, and satisfaction of charges.
* Other event-based statutory filings.
* Maintain statutory registers and records under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Ensure compliance with applicable provisions relating to deposits, loans, investments, related-party transactions, and other corporate actions.

**E. Insider Trading and Shareholder Management**

* Administer the Code of Conduct for prevention of insider trading.
* Manage trading window closures, pre-clearance of trades, and disclosures by designated persons.
* Maintain the list of designated persons and their immediate relatives, as applicable.
* Coordinate with the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) and depositories.
* Monitor shareholding patterns, investor grievances, and shareholder-related disclosures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements relating to dematerialisation, share transfers, and corporate actions.

**F. Legal and Regulatory Advisory**

* Advise management on corporate law, listing obligations, governance, and regulatory matters.
* Identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure timely closure of statutory obligations.
* Support due diligence, corporate restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and other corporate transactions, wherever applicable.
* Assist in responding to regulatory queries, notices, and stock exchange observations.

**3. Eligibility Criteria**

* Qualified Company Secretary and member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* Graduate in Commerce, Law, or a related discipline.
* 3-5 years of relevant experience, preferably with a listed company.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in SEBI LODR, Companies Act, 2013, and stock exchange compliances.
* Experience in handling Board and Committee meetings, annual reports, and corporate governance reporting.
* Good drafting, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MCA portal filings, NSE/BSE compliance portals, and compliance management systems.

**4. Preferred Experience**

* Experience with a company listed on NSE and/or BSE.
* Exposure to quarterly and annual compliance reporting and event-based disclosures.
* Experience in Annual Secretarial Compliance Reports and Secretarial Audit coordination.
* Familiarity with SEBI PIT Regulations, SDD maintenance, and related-party transaction compliances.
* Experience coordinating with statutory auditors, Practising Company Secretaries, legal counsel, and stock exchange officials.
* Exposure to corporate restructuring, fundraising, preferential issues, rights issues, or other capital market transactions.

**5. Key Competencies**

**Competency**

**Expected capability**

Regulatory knowledge

Strong understanding of Companies Act and SEBI regulations

Listed company experience

Independent handling of stock exchange compliances

Corporate governance

Effective Board and Committee management

Drafting skills

Notices, minutes, resolutions, disclosures, and reports

Compliance management

Proactive tracking and timely filing

Communication

Effective coordination with Directors and senior management

Attention to detail

Accuracy in statutory records and regulatory disclosures

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of all applicable ROC, MCA, and stock exchange filings.
* Zero avoidable penalties or compliance defaults.
* Timely disclosure of material events and information.
* Accurate preparation of Board and Committee documentation.
* Timely submission of corporate governance reports and annual disclosures.
* Effective maintenance of the compliance calendar, statutory registers, and SDD.
* Timely resolution of shareholder grievances and regulatory observations.

title: Risk and Compliance Analyst
description:
Posted Thursday, 15 October 2026 at 14:30

**CACI International Inc is an American multinational professional services and information technology company headquartered in Northern Virginia.**

**CACI provides expertise and technology to enterprise and mission customers in support of national security missions and government transformation for defense, intelligence, and civilian customers.**

**CACI has approximately 23,000 employees worldwide.**

**Headquartered in London, CACI Ltd is a wholly owned subsidiary of CACI International Inc., a publicly listed company on the NYSE with annual revenue in excess of US $6.2bn.**

**Founded in 2022, CACI India is an exciting, growing and progressive business unit of CACI Ltd. CACI Ltd currently has over 2000 intelligent professionals and are now adding many more from our Hyderabad and Pune offices. Through a rigorous emphasis on quality, the CACI India has grown considerably to become one of the UKs most well-respected Technology centres.**

  

**Network Risk and Compliance Analyst:**

This role is positioned as a Network Risk and Compliance within the Production Assurance-Risk and Compliance Team. The Risk and Compliance team is responsible for proactively identifying and managing risks and to ensure oversight and accuracy of our audit and regulatory responses and remediation plans.

  

**Primary responsibilities will include:**

* Develop and manage monitoring activities to ensure compliance with Information Security and Technology regulatory requirements and internal policies and standards

* Identify, develop and maintain key risk indicators to track and ensure compliance with established policies and standards

* Conduct targeted reviews to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement

* Proactively identify and report Information Security and Technology compliance risks

* Ensure risks are effectively identified, quantified, prioritized, communicated, and managed, including recommendations for risk mitigation, and identifying the root cause/key themes

* Effectively communicate findings and recommendations to management in detailed and organized format/process via presentations to stakeholders and senior management

* Audit, Regulatory and Third-Part audits/risk assessments

* Development of formal responses to Audit and Regulatory inquiries or assessments. This may be comprised of documentation gathering, drafting of documents, and researching past activity and reports

* Centralize compliance responses/data to improve audit response time and create consistent responses across teams

* Interact with Auditors and Regulators as needed

* Develop and conduct ongoing risk and compliance training and education

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Information Systems Management, Information Technology Auditing or related relevant field

* Strong technical background in order to communicate effectively with Network Engineers

* Experience in leading projects, preferably global projects

* Experience with audits and/or compliance assessments/monitoring

* PMI, CISSP, CISM, CISA a plus

* Ability to operate in a fast-paced global environment

* Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines and embrace change

* Ability to communicate clearly to various levels of management (including executive management), across various business functions (including engineering)

title: Legal Associate - Corporate Law
description:

title: Senior Legal Counsel - India
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India. On site at the offices of Unseen Realities.

**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Reporting To:** Chief Legal Officer, Analog

**About Analog and Unseen Realities**
-------------------------------------

**Analog is pioneering the era of physical intelligence.** Where digital intelligence transformed our online lives, Analog is transforming the lived world, making cities more adaptive, industries more resilient, services more human centered, and experiences more extraordinary.

At the heart of our approach are living world models, continuously updated, enriched by every capture point, every device, every interaction. Within them resides Ana, the Analog Neural Agent. Ana perceives, adapts, and guides, transforming raw data into foresight and orchestration that improves outcomes across sectors, from safeguarding high value assets to enhancing human performance.

**Unseen Realities, based out of Hyderabad, Telangana, is part of the Analog group, and serves as Analog's operating entity in India supporting customers and partners in the region**. It will also serve as Analog's research and development hub in India, building engineering and applied AI capabilities that feed the global Analog platform. Everyone joining Unseen Realities works as part of the wider Analog group, and has the opportunity to shape how physical intelligence takes root in one of the world's fastest-growing technology markets.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Legal Counsel to lead the full spectrum of Unseen Realities’ legal needs, and serve as the primary legal point of contact for Analog’s business, operations, and opportunities in India. As the first India-based counsel at Unseen Realities, you will work independently and will be the India law and market expert for the Analog legal team. At the same time, you will be a full member of the Analog legal team, working closely with and supported by your colleagues in the Abu Dhabi office.

The successful candidate will take end to end ownership of Indian corporate law and governance, company secretarial processes, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and the management of Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture and its participation in wider Analog group arrangements, which together form the core of the role. This is a unique opportunity to shape key business decisions and drive Analog’s growth within a fast evolving technology market in India.

In this highly visible role, you will also lead intellectual property licensing and technology transactions in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of Analog’s intellectual property in customer, supplier and joint venture-facing arrangements, safeguarding Analog’s legal interests while fostering strategic relationships with our partners, as Analog expands its portfolio of physical intelligence-driven products into India.

You will also oversee legal risk management, employment matters, disputes, and legal operations, including the supervision of external counsel and the project management of legal matters across the business.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will own a broad range of legal matters, with a critical focus on Indian corporate law and governance, corporate processes, joint venture management, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and a working understanding of intellectual property and technology transaction issues.

You will:

**India corporate law, governance and corporate actions**

* Own, with support from external company secretarial providers where appropriate, all corporate and company secretarial processes for Unseen Realities, including convening board and shareholder meetings, preparing agendas, notices, board and shareholder resolutions, circulation resolutions and minutes, and supporting board / committee governance processes.
* Manage key corporate actions, including share issuances and transfers, dividends and other distributions, amendments to the constitutional documents, maintenance of share capital and shareholding records, and the creation and satisfaction of charges.
* Manage director and officer appointments, resignations and removals, including director identification number (DIN), know your customer (KYC) requirements and related filings.
* Oversee the maintenance of statutory registers, statutory filings, and the compliance calendar under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Coordinate exchange control and foreign investment reporting for inbound investment into Unseen Realities and for any joint venture shareholding, including FC-GPR / FC-TRS filings, and downstream investment reporting under the Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, working with the authorized dealer bank and external counsel where required.

**Commercial contracting**

* Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including master services agreements, technology and software arrangements, intellectual property licenses, supplier and subcontractor terms, procurement and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, data processing / privacy terms, and customer facing terms.
* Review and negotiate channel, reseller, distribution, system integrator, consortium and joint bidding arrangements, including arrangements entered into in order to respond to requests for proposal, public procurement processes, and tenders in India.
* Provide legal expertise on memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and partnership agreements, and advise business stakeholders on contractual risk, liability, and compliance considerations.
* Develop and maintain Indian law contract templates, playbooks and fallback positions for use across the business, streamlining the contracting process and reducing reliance on external counsel.

**Analog group and joint venture arrangements**

* Manage Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture or partnership arrangements, including the exercise of its rights and the performance of its obligations under any joint venture or shareholders’ agreements and joint venture constitutional documents, reserved matter approvals, delegation of authority implementation, and support for the directors and shareholder representatives appointed by Unseen Realities.
* Negotiate and administer the corporate and commercial arrangements between Unseen Realities and its joint venture partners or joint venture entities, and between Unseen Realities and other Analog group companies, including product sales agreements, intellectual property licenses, branding arrangements, technology arrangements, and services arrangements, in each case on arm’s length terms.
* Coordinate with your colleagues in the Analog legal function on Analog group corporate governance and related party transaction requirements.

**Regulatory, risk management and compliance**

* Provide legal advice on Indian regulatory matters and ensure that all agreements and business activities comply with applicable Indian laws and regulations, including the Companies Act, 2013, exchange control and foreign investment rules, data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, labour and employment laws, competition law, anti-bribery and anti-corruption legislation, and sector-specific regulations, as applicable.
* Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of compliance programs and internal policies, including adapting the Analog group’s compliance and other policies to address local law deviations where necessary.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate legal and compliance risks to protect Analog’s business in India.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments in India to assess impact on the business.

**Intellectual Property and licensing**

* Advise on intellectual property ownership and manage intellectual property licensing arrangements in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of the Analog group’s intellectual property, including in customer, partner and joint venture facing contracts.
* Manage, through external agents, Indian trade mark, patent, copyright and design filings and prosecution, and manage brand use, enforcement, and domain name issues.

**Legal operations, cross functional collaboration and management of external counsel**

* Work closely with your colleagues in the Analog legal function and with the India business to ensure that legal considerations are aligned with business strategies and embedded into business operations.
* Instruct and manage Indian external counsel, company secretarial providers and other advisers, ensuring cost effective and comprehensive legal support and control of legal spend.

**Employment and HR legal support**

* Advise the Analog People team on employment matters, including hiring, terminations, disciplinary matters, investigations and employee relations, coordinating with external legal counsels for specialist or sensitive matters.
* Draft and review employment contracts, consultant and contractor agreements, policies, and internal guidelines.

**Litigation and dispute management**

* Manage and oversee, with external counsel, litigation, arbitration, regulatory matters, notices, and pre-litigation correspondence in India.
* Develop dispute-resolution strategies aligned with business objectives and escalate material disputes to the Analog CLO and relevant business stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. from a recognized Indian university, or an equivalent legal degree enabling enrolment with a State Bar Council in India.
* Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE), with demonstrable depth in both (i) Indian corporate law and processes, including board and shareholder matters, corporate actions and statutory filings, and (ii) commercial contracts governed by Indian law.
* Strong background in contract negotiation, regulatory compliance, risk management, and external counsel management, including budget and performance oversight.
* Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical business advice in support of business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently as, initially, the sole legal resource based in India, and to collaborate as part of a geographically distributed team in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
* Qualified to practice law in India, including enrolment with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act 1961, whether current or suspended for the duration of full time salaried employment.
* Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate to Hyderabad, and able to work from the offices of Unseen Realities. Ability to travel within India, and occasionally internationally, as business needs require, would be helpful.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior in-house experience, preferably in a technology business.
* Experience advising an India subsidiary or India joint venture of a foreign-headquartered or multinational group.
* Strong experience in Indian intellectual property law, particularly intellectual property licensing, ownership, brand use, and India market technology transactions.
* Strong working knowledge of technology law, data protection, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the regulatory framework applicable to technology businesses in India, including procurement and tendering by government and public sector customers.
* Experience of joint venture governance, including exchange control and downstream investment requirements.
* Experience advising on AI-related legal issues and understanding of the ethical, regulatory, and commercial implications of AI.
* Proven ability to manage complex legal projects and advise senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* High level of integrity, judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
* Experience of company secretarial processes, and of working with company secretaries, registrars and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal filings.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or Telugu, in addition to English, would be an advantage but is not essential.

**What Working at Analog Offers**
---------------------------------

**Culture:** A collaborative, globally minded team building the future of physical intelligence. We value curiosity, courage, and creativity, and we’re united by a belief that technology should amplify human potential rather than replace it.

**Impact:** The opportunity to work on projects with national and global significance, from adaptive cities and resilient infrastructure to next generation sports, entertainment, healthcare, and energy. Every product you help build contributes to shaping a safer, smarter, more human centered world.

**Growth:** Outstanding opportunities for learning and career development. You’ll collaborate with leaders across AI, robotics, mixed reality, and systems engineering, while working on industry first, frontier scale solutions.

**Rewards:** A competitive compensation package.

**Unseen Realities is an equal opportunity employer**. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with applicable law and without discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable laws of India.

title: Application Security Compliance Lead
description:
**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Title: Application Security Compliance Lead**

**Location: Gurgaon or Hyderabad, India**

**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) is a global technology company that enables financial access and commerce through assisted and self\-service solutions and comprehensive support services. NCR Atleos serves financial and public\-sector organizations in more than 100 countries and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.

**The opportunity**


As an Application Security Compliance Specialist, you will help ensure that NCR Atleos software products and development practices meet applicable security, privacy and regulatory requirements. Working within our global Application Security team, you will turn complex requirements into practical guidance, prepare teams for assessments, and help demonstrate that security and privacy are embedded throughout the software lifecycle.


A major focus is organization\-level **PCI Software Security Framework****(SSF)** activities: support product teams to achieve and retain PCI Secure Software Standard listings and maintain validation of our Secure Software Lifecycle practices. This role suits someone who combines compliance expertise with software development and application security knowledge.

**What you will do**

* Govern the Secure SDLC. Maintain and improve practices aligned with the PCI Secure SLC Standard.
* Enable PCI SSF validation. Guide teams through external assessment, self\-assessment, annual attestation and periodic revalidation activities.
* Interpret requirements. Translate security, privacy, legal and industry requirements into clear, proportionate guidance.
* Assess readiness and close gaps. Coordinate reviews, evidence, gap analysis, remediation and resolution of findings.
* Engage and influence. Partner with engineering, Legal, risk, compliance and security teams, QSAs and the PCI SSC.
* Build capability. Create training and reusable guidance; monitor developments and communicate material changes.
* Drive continual improvement. Use industry changes, stakeholder feedback, internal audits, assessment outcomes, recurring findings, and incidents to strengthen controls and processes.
**What you will bring**

**Essential experience and capabilities**

* Typically, 7\+ years of relevant experience in application security, software security assurance, secure software development, technology risk, privacy, compliance, or audit.
* Practical experience developing, operating, governing or assessing a Secure SDLC.
* Experience interpreting security or compliance requirements and supporting assessments, evidence collection, gap analysis and remediation.
* Working knowledge of threat modelling, vulnerability management, security testing, and risk\-based decision\-making.
* Technical understanding of cloud services, source\-code management, and CI/CD practices sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to convert complex requirements into pragmatic guidance and make evidence\-based recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within a globally distributed team.
* Comfortable using AI assistants, such as Copilot, responsibly in day\-to\-day work to improve personal productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.
* A bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience and qualifications.
**Desirable experience and capabilities**

* Direct experience of PCI SSF validation or a comparable software security assurance framework.
* Knowledge of payment\-card security, GDPR requirements, NIST CSF and OWASP standards and guidance.
* Experience delivering application security or compliance\-related training.
* Knowledge of security and governance for AI\-enabled software development and products.
* A relevant certification, such as CISSP, CSSLP, CIPP, CIPT or CIPM.
 **How you will succeed**

* Teams receive clear, timely, and actionable compliance guidance.
* PCI SSF validation activities are well planned, appropriately evidenced, and progressed effectively.
* Compliance gaps and findings are clearly owned, prioritized, tracked, and resolved.
* Secure SDLC requirements remain practical, current, and consistently understood.
* Assessment and incident lessons lead to sustainable improvements and strong stakeholder relationships.
**Evidence we value**


In your application, we would particularly welcome examples of how you have interpreted a security standard, prepared a product or organization for assessment, resolved a significant compliance gap, or influenced an engineering team to adopt a more effective security practice.


Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job\-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

description:
### **Legal**

### **1 Open Positions**

### **15\-20 years**

### **Hyderabad**

### **Objective**

We are seeking a highly experienced Litigation Specialist to join our in\-house legal team in Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in litigation, with prior experience as an advocate and extensive in\-house legal expertise. This role involves managing complex legal disputes, providing strategic advice on litigation matters, and leveraging professional networks to ensure efficient case handling. The candidate must hold an LLB degree and demonstrate a proven track record in high\-stakes legal environments.


### **Professional Network**

Established contacts with Advocates on Record (AOR) or other advocates on record, particularly for handling matters in appellate courts.


### **Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in law (LLB) from a recognized university; additional qualifications such as LLM or specialized certifications in litigation would be advantageous.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end litigation processes, including case assessment, strategy development, drafting pleadings, and representing the company in court proceedings as needed.
* Provide in\-house legal counsel on dispute resolution, risk mitigation, and compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
* Collaborate with external counsel, including Advocates on Record (AOR), to handle matters in higher courts such as the Supreme Court or High Courts.
* Conduct legal research, analyse case precedents, and prepare reports on ongoing litigations.
* Negotiate settlements, mediate disputes, and advise on alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.
* Maintain and utilize a strong network of legal contacts, including AORs and other advocates, to facilitate smooth case progression.
* Ensure all litigation activities align with company policies, ethical standards, and timelines.
* Mentor junior legal staff and contribute to the development of internal legal strategies.
### **Required Skills / Qualifications**

* Expertise in Indian legal frameworks, including CPC, CrPC, Evidence Act, and relevant commercial laws.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in legal research tools and case management software.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple cases simultaneously.
